Companion to [oss-monorepo#6832](https://github.com/Duncan-Haywood/oss-monorepo/pull/6832), which folds this repository into `oss-monorepo` under `research/` with full history. `fp-monorepo` was that repository's old name.

- `README.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `prompt.md` now point at `oss-monorepo` and at the research track of its prompt system (`prompts/research/`).
- The freeze stays: scheduled runs here still leave no trace. They now reply that the work moved and ask for the routine to be pointed at `oss-monorepo`.

Draft until oss-monorepo#6832 merges, since these notices say it has. No projects change.
